nodes.rationale: Role specification and coding heuristics for cosmological simulations using DPC++

nodes.label: Pointer-Free Prime Directive
nodes.rationale: All relationships between tree nodes must be expressed as integer indices referencing contiguous arrays to allow raw MPI byte transfers.

nodes.label: Structure of Arrays (SoA) Mandatory Layout
nodes.rationale: Avoid AoS to guarantee coalesced memory access across SIMT warps on NVIDIA GPUs.

nodes.label: System Design SYCL-HLBVH
nodes.rationale: Architectural design for spatial search in cosmological simulations

nodes.label: Pointer-Free Tree Topologies
nodes.rationale: Tree topologies use integer indices into contiguous vectors for efficient serialization over MPI.

nodes.label: Structure of Arrays Data Layout
nodes.rationale: Guarantees coalesced memory access across SIMT warps on NVIDIA GPUs.

nodes.label: SYCL and oneDPL Heterogeneous Backend
nodes.rationale: Provides single-source C++ standard targeting NVIDIA GPUs via Codeplay plugin and oneDPL algorithms.

nodes.label: HLBVH Pipeline Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Modified LBVH pipeline with Morton codes, CSD, intra-voxel sorting, and treelet emission.

nodes.label: Compress-Sort-Decompress (CSD) Pattern
nodes.rationale: Compresses particles into coarse spatial grids, sorts block descriptors, and decompresses.

nodes.label: Intra-Voxel Local Memory Sort
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained odd-even sort inside SYCL local memory to minimize global memory bandwidth.

nodes.label: Range and kNN Query Traversal
nodes.rationale: Non-recursive stack-based traversal minimizing divergent execution paths across threads.

nodes.label: HLBVH Pantaleoni & Luebke Paper
nodes.rationale: Foundational algorithm for parallel hierarchy construction on modern GPUs.
